---
description: Fix one confirmed security finding with the smallest safe patch
agent: Security Reviewer
---

Work on exactly one confirmed finding.

1. Reconfirm the attack path.
2. Make the smallest safe code or dependency change.
3. Prefer native .NET/Angular/Yarn capabilities and existing dependencies.
4. Add or update a focused regression test.
5. Run focused build/tests and the relevant security verification.
6. Do not weaken security controls, suppress the finding, or perform unrelated refactoring.
7. Report changed files and verification results.
